rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Scope Guard enforces scope boundaries in multi-agent systems, preventing scope drift, work duplication, and conflicting actions between coordinating agents. It tracks claimed task scopes and raises conflicts when agents attempt to overlap responsibilities. The server installs as an npm package and integrates with orchestration frameworks.
